name: T13-am-kill
description: Background, then kill the process 5s later.

steps.why: ON_STOP lands at ~1.35s and the ack at ~+700ms after that, so a kill here falls INSIDE the ack window. At the old 5s the kill could never race the upload, which is why every past run reported the same non-finding.
long enough to see whether the snapshot is recovered on the next process start
